name: cizle
title: cizle skills: video prompts and Claude Code skills for product, ad and launch videos
description: A library of video skills and prompts for Claude Code, plus a gallery of 1,000+ credited Opus 5.5 video prompts from the community. Copy a prompt or install a skill, give it your product link, and render an animated MP4 on your own machine. 20 free skills, premium ad and film-style skills and the full gallery for $10 a month.
